title: The Memory Witness: A Simulated Investigation · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short paragraph (about 100 words) about a time when you or someone you know forgot something important. Use at least one conditional sentence and one reason sentence. Explain what happened and what you learned.
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
